description: Controlled vocabulary values for the internal audit management and tracking system

values.Label: Full Report
values.Description: Complete audit report with all findings and recommendations

values.Label: Follow-Up Report
values.Description: Report on status of previously identified observations

values.Label: Letter Report
values.Description: Abbreviated report in letter format

value_groups.description: Lifecycle status of an audit observation

values.Label: Open
values.Description: Observation has been identified and is awaiting action

values.Label: In Progress
values.Description: Corrective action is underway

values.Label: Closed
values.Description: Observation has been fully resolved

values.Label: Closed at First Follow Up
values.Description: Observation resolved and verified at the first follow-up review

value_groups.description: Lifecycle status of a corrective action item

values.Label: Open
values.Description: Action item has been created but work has not started

values.Label: In Progress
values.Description: Work on the action item is underway

values.Label: Completed
values.Description: Action item has been fulfilled

values.Label: Overdue
values.Description: Action item has passed its target completion date

values.Label: Closed
values.Description: Action item has been verified and closed

value_groups.description: Severity level of an audit observation

values.Label: High
values.Description: Significant risk requiring immediate attention

values.Label: Medium
values.Description: Moderate risk requiring timely remediation

values.Label: Low
values.Description: Minor risk or process improvement opportunity

value_groups.description: Roles assigned to personnel for audit action items

values.Label: Implementing Employee
values.Description: Person responsible for executing the corrective action

values.Label: Reviewing Manager
values.Description: Manager responsible for verifying corrective action completion

value_groups.description: Priority level for scheduling and resource allocation

values.Label: High
values.Description: Requires immediate attention and resource allocation

values.Label: Medium
values.Description: Standard priority for normal workflow

values.Label: Low
values.Description: Can be addressed as resources allow

value_groups.description: Classification of documents associated with audits

values.Label: Source Audit PDF
values.Description: Original audit report PDF for data extraction

values.Label: Supporting Evidence
values.Description: Documentation supporting corrective action completion

values.Label: Correspondence
values.Description: Communications related to audit findings

values.Label: Other Document
values.Description: Other document types not otherwise classified

value_groups.description: Status of AI-assisted data extraction from audit documents

values.Label: Pending
values.Description: Document uploaded but extraction has not started

values.Label: OCR In Progress
values.Description: Optical character recognition is running

values.Label: OCR Complete
values.Description: OCR finished, text is available for LLM processing

values.Label: LLM In Progress
values.Description: Large language model is extracting structured data

values.Label: Awaiting Human Review
values.Description: Extraction complete, awaiting human verification

values.Label: Approved
values.Description: Extracted data has been verified and approved

values.Label: Rejected
values.Description: Extracted data was rejected and requires re-processing

values.Label: Failed
values.Description: Extraction process encountered an unrecoverable error
